messages.subject: Re: DWLS
parts:
On 12/13/2014 09:26 AM, Jia-Jen Chen wrote:
> Hi everyone,
> If I only have covariance matrix and want to use estimator="DWLS", what
> the diagonal matrix should I provide?
> That is, how do get this "matrix"?

I am afraid you need the full data to compute this matrix. It is the the
diagonal of a weight matrix which is based on an estimate of the
asymptotic variance matrix of all sample statistics (thresholds,
correlations, etc).

In other words, if you only have a covariance matrix, you can not use
DWLS. You can use ULS.

Yves.
